title: Cohomology of Flag Superschemes and Syzygies of Compositional Varieties
summary: We study the coherent cohomology of partial flag supervarieties and calculate the sheaf cohomology of the structure sheaves of four new infinite families of flag supervarieties. We introduce compositional varieties, a generalization of determinantal varieties obtained by imposing rank conditions on compositions of a pair of maps. We study geometric properties of compositional varieties and, in cases of interest, compute their $\mathrm{Tor}$-groups.
